    German Ambassador Vito Cecere visits Rosenbauer

    24. August 2026

about rosenbauer

Innovative in firefighting for160 years.

Rosenbauer is the world's leading manufacturer of firefighting equipment for fire protection and disaster control. For 160 years, the name has stood for significant innovations and groundbreaking technologies in the construction of fire engines and firefighting equipment according to European and US standards. As a full-range supplier, Rosenbauer offers the fire service municipal fire engines, turntable ladders, aerial rescue platforms, airport vehicles, industrial vehicles, special vehicles, extinguishing systems, fire-fighting equipment, stationary extinguishing systems and, in the area of digital solutions, solutions for vehicle management and operations management. Rosenbauer provides maintenance, customer service and refurbishment through its service network in over 100 countries.
